title: Score
body: Every model in the pool is scored on your last ten thousand requests, per task type, by a judge model you pick.

title: Rank
body: Your policy orders the pool — cheapest above a quality floor, fastest, best, or longest context — per request.

title: Route
body: The request goes to the top model. If it degrades, the next one takes it. You see which, and why, in the log.
